title: xanthoxalis exilis
intro: Xanthoxalis exilis, commonly known as Yellow Wood Sorrel, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Oxalidaceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing oxidative stress and inflammation in the body. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion and relieve gastrointestinal issues, such as bloating and indigestion. Xanthoxalis exilis contains bioactive constituents like oxalic acid, flavonoids, and ascorbic acid, which contribute to its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential benefits in treating various health conditions.
